You will also be able to have peace in your 4 bedroom 2 bath home with a large backyard fully fenced for privacy. The Owner's Suit offers a large walk-in closet with a soaking tub and separate shower, and with double vanity. All bedrooms are carpeted and one minor bedroom offers direct access to the guest bath. The kitchen has plenty of room with a breakfast bar and breakfast nook. There is a formal dining room to have a family dinner or relax at the end of the day in the living room where the home has a wood-burning fireplace.
